searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he final implementation plan the awtsmoos now binds chessed of possibility to gevurah of exact files and tests; awtsmoos.com will change only after each dependency has shown the shape in which it rests. before source mutation 1. fetch origin/main and verify current root/relevant file concurrency. 2. read the exact current chitas files in full. 3. locate and read the normal post reader route/loader in full using narrow file discovery. 4. read the internal tanach source adapter/payload in full. 5. freeze exact touched file list. generic reference system files create small modules under geelooy/heichelos/heichel/modules/dynamic reference/: reference contract.js: validate typed ordered references; no ui or network. reference id.js: stable url safe dynamic post identity helpers. reference registry.js: adapter registration and dispatch. post composer.js: resolve ordered references into one normal post reader model. if the existing reader already exposes equivalent composition primitives, reduce this set rather than duplicate them. chitas files chitas/range reference.js: translate schedule aliyah boundaries to the chosen internal tanach/post range model. chitas/week state.js: parse/serialize date, language, israel/diaspora and week navigation. chitas/dynamic post.js: reconstruct chitas yyyy mm dd from url state and resolve selected torah range. chitas/week controls.js: pure ui model for selector labels and actions. rewrite schedule.js only if needed to output structured boundaries in addition to display labels. rewrite virtual series.js so cards are ordinary internal posts with no externalhref and no social suppression marker. existing reader/navigation integration fully rewrite the located post loader/router so seriesid === daily chitas + postid === chitas yyyy mm dd resolves through chitas/dynamic post.js; ordinary persisted posts retain existing path. keep the existing native post/tanach reader and comments/social components. add a small chitas masthead module/style rather than fork the reader. rewrite living path/cards.js to remove chabad allowlist/external navigation and make chitas cards follow the ordinary internal post route. week and language ux segmented hebrew / english selector. previous week, today, next week buttons. date input allowing any selected week/day. english + hebrew parsha title. sunday→shabbos cards with selected/today states. url query is the source of truth and supports hard reload/back/forward. minimum 48px mobile actions where practical. reader ux chitas masthead: weekday, aliyah, selected date, parsha, canonical range. native torah typography/body. rtl hebrew and ltr english scoped to text. normal comments/social/share controls. verse comments retain canonical versesection. no external torah study navigation. tests to write/update 1. dynamic reference contract parse/validate/serialize tests. 2. range parser tests for same chapter and cross chapter aliyos. 3. stable dynamic post id and reload reconstruction tests. 4. week state tests: any date, previous/next/today, hebrew/english, israel/diaspora. 5. existing chitas schedule tests including festival deferral, simchas torah, isru chag. 6. living path contract: chitas cards have internal ids and no externalhref/chabad host. 7. normal post card regression: ordinary internal navigation/social remains intact. 8. reader integration: direct daily chitas url resolves internal torah text. 9. comment integration: comments ui exists; versesection source identity is stable. 10. browser 320/375/390/430: no horizontal overflow, no dock overlap, selectors usable, language/date/week state correct, hostname remains awtsmoos.com. 11. browser hard reload of a selected hebrew week/post. 12. search changed subtree for chabad.org, externalhref, virtualstudy. verification / deployment read back every touched file completely. compare this plan against actual implementation and write a new non overwriting delta file. if anything is missing, perform a second complete file write pass. re read all touched files again and write final plan vs actual audit. run node syntax/tests, line ceiling, tab indentation checks, prologues, git diff check. fetch newest origin, integrate concurrent canonical work, rerun affected gates. commit and push exact sha without force. activate through the repository production release path. verify public bytes and real ikar mobile flow from grouping → selected week → chitas post → torah text/comments. completion invariant the task is not complete merely when a card opens. completion means the current screenshot failure is impossible: clicking chitas remains on awtsmoos, resolves our torah source, preserves normal comments/social, supports arbitrary week and hebrew/english state, formats correctly on mobile, survives hard reload, and is live in production.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he native tanach + existing range reference revelation the awtsmoos has revealed that the missing chitas reader does not require another torah store; awtsmoos.com already keeps the written torah as book series, chapter posts, and one pasuk per section at the native reader's door. new hard evidence thewrittentorah contains the canonical tanach book series, including bereishis, shemos, vayikra, bamidbar, and devarim. devarim contains 34 posts, exactly its 34 chapters; bereishis contains 50 posts, exactly its 50 chapters. devarim chapter 31 is the 31st post in the series and its dayuh.sections contains one hebrew pasuk per array entry. bereishis chapter 1 has the same shape. the post metadata records canonical provenance such as sourcebooktitle, sourcechapter, and canonicalhebrew. the entity universe range reference engine already models living source windows and source comment pointers, but its entity store is currently empty and its two end selector does not yet select an ordered contiguous span. the unfinished torah library /search/library/browse client is not backed by the currently running local api and must not become a chitas dependency. native post reader bootstrap loads a post object, manifests it, then starts normal comments/discussion/translation. therefore a synthetic chitas post should enter at coordinates.js, not fork the reader. revised architecture 1. keep the existing entity range reference engine and improve contiguous range semantics generically. 2. add a browser side post range compositor that treats ordinary persisted posts as canonical range sources without copying them into entity storage. 3. a tanach reference such as deuteronomy 31:20 31:30 maps deterministically to devarim, chapter indexes 31→31, and verse indexes 20→30. 4. cross chapter references fetch only the required chapter posts and concatenate only the required section slices. 5. each composed section carries source metadata: heichel, series, source post id, chapter, verse, and stable versesection. 6. coordinates.js intercepts only seriesid === daily chitas + postid === chitas yyyy mm dd, synthesizes a normal post, then the existing reader/comments pipeline continues unchanged. 7. chitas list cards become ordinary internal post cards. externalhref, chabad host allowlisting, and virtualstudy social suppression disappear. 8. week/date/language state is url addressable. the canonical torah source remains hebrew; english ui is supported immediately, while actual english torah text may use the existing reader translation layer when available rather than fabricating a translation. 9. a chitas masthead is a small reader extension above native torah text, not a parallel page. 10. comments for the dynamic post remain normal awtsmoos comments; source verse metadata is retained so a future source comment jump can reuse the existing range reference comment pointer model. exact first implementation files new small modules under geelooy/heichelos/post/logic/chitas/: books.js, rangeparser.js, postrangeloader.js, dynamicpost.js, weekstate.js, masthead.js. rewrite current coordinates.js to delegate daily chitas resolution before persisted series/post fetch. rewrite chitas schedule.js, hebcal provider.js, virtual series.js, and living path cards.js as complete files. rewrite postmanifest.js only to call the masthead extension before ordinary post body rendering. extend server rangereferences.js as a complete file rewrite so start+end selects the real contiguous flattened span. completion proof a chitas click must remain on awtsmoos, render the exact native hebrew pesukim from canonical chapter posts, show the ordinary reader/comments chrome, support arbitrary selected week/date, survive hard reload, and contain zero chabad.org/externalhref/virtualstudy behavior in the active chitas path.
